pyx.definition:
n. a chest in which coins from the mint are held to await assay
n. any receptacle in which wafers for the Eucharist are kept
pyx.translation:
n. 圣体容器, 硬币样品盒
vt. 检验(硬币的)重量和纯度

pyxides.definition:
n fruit of such plants as the plantain; a capsule whose upper part falls off when the seeds are released
n a constellation in the southern hemisphere near Puppis and Antlia
n a small box used by ancient Greeks to hold medicines
pyxides.translation: n. (pyxis的复数)药箱, 宝石盒,[植]盖果

pyxidia.translation: n. 盖果( pyxidium的名词复数 )

pyxidium.definition: n. fruit of such plants as the plantain; a capsule whose upper part falls off when the seeds are released

pyxie.definition: n creeping evergreen shrub having narrow overlapping leaves and early white star-shaped flowers; of the pine barrens of New Jersey and the Carolinas

pyxis.definition:
n. a constellation in the southern hemisphere near Puppis and Antlia
n. a small box used by ancient Greeks to hold medicines
pyxis.translation:
n. 有盖瓶, 小箱
[医] 盖果
